tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Motion-graphics canvas behind the reel visuals.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Line icons, outlines and diagram strokes on ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one key value per frame: numbers, highlights, the hero block. Never as text on ground (1.4:1).

tokens.name: caption-pill
tokens.usage: Caption background pill. Sits on ground, footage or chroma-key.

tokens.name: caption-text
tokens.usage: Caption words on caption-pill (19.8:1).

tokens.name: caption-highlight
tokens.usage: Caption words that hold a number or % (rupees, runs, percentages), on caption-pill (13.7:1).

tokens.name: chroma-key
tokens.usage: Flat green canvas for the caption-only overlay pass. Never used inside a graphic.

families.caption: "Avenir LT Pro", "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: caption-word
styles.usage: Every caption word, on a 1080x1920 canvas. Shrinks to fit when a phrase runs past cap-max-line.

styles.name: label-kick
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels inside the motion graphics, never in captions.

tokens.name: cap-pad-x
tokens.usage: Pill padding left and right of the phrase.

tokens.name: cap-height
tokens.usage: Pill height; one line only.

tokens.name: cap-top
tokens.usage: Pill top edge on the 1920px-tall canvas (bottom edge 1528px), clear of the bottom 18% app UI.

tokens.name: cap-max-line
tokens.usage: Widest a phrase may run before its font shrinks to fit.

tokens.name: cap-rise
tokens.usage: How far below its resting line each word starts.

tokens.name: cap-exit
tokens.usage: How far the old line lifts as the next phrase takes over.

tokens.name: cap-radius
tokens.usage: Caption pill corners.

timing.note: Caption motion, in seconds. Times are measured against each word's start in the SRT.

tokens.name: cap-word-lead
tokens.usage: A word starts rising this long before its SRT start.

tokens.name: cap-word-rise
tokens.usage: Rise and fade-in of one word.

tokens.name: cap-line-swap
tokens.usage: Old line lifts out when the next phrase follows straight on.

tokens.name: cap-pill-morph
tokens.usage: Pill width change between joined phrases.

tokens.name: cap-pill-in
tokens.usage: Pill fades in and scales 94 to 100% after a pause.

tokens.name: cap-pill-out
tokens.usage: Pill fades and scales to 96% before a pause.

tokens.name: cap-hold
tokens.usage: Pill stays this long after the last word when a pause over 0.9s follows.

tokens.name: cap-ease
tokens.usage: Cubic ease-in-out for every caption move. No bounce, no overshoot.
